text: The appraisal and NPA asset product of rwb-source-data, the case-state read of rwb-case and its case-move answer are consumed on their documented shapes with a placeholder for the operation name, and are faked until their owners publish the names.
why: No source publishes the operation names and the C row of this slice is None, so the build cannot wait for them at wave 3.
read: Architecture v5 slide 8; Ownership Map; TSD S5 T5.2; legacy RWB-E4-025 Endpoints
applied_in: RWB-S5-E4025-APP s3 and s12.2; RWB-S5-E4025-CON s12.2 and s12.8
confirm: Owner of rwb-source-data (P1) and owner of rwb-case (P3) at the contract tag
impact: Three consumed rows and one fake carry the placeholder; a published name replaces it in a minor version.

text: The bid amount and its bidder are held against the round row the rounds story owns, the second signature is read from the rwb-decision approval item, and no column is added to rwb_asset for either.
why: R-DIS-41 conditions on bid_amount and R-DIS-42 on second_signature_by while TSD S5 T3.1 names neither, and inventing a column would break the rule that no source value is invented.
read: TSD S5 T3.1 and T3.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-41 and R-DIS-42; FSD S5 A2.16.3.2
applied_in: RWB-S5-E4025-APP s4, s11 and s12.7; RWB-S5-E4025-CON s11 and s12.7
confirm: Solution architect and the DB story of the service at the physical schema review
impact: No migration is written for the bid or the signature; both elements stay Not specified in the source documents until the LDM names a column.

text: The accepted bid rides POST /listings/{listingId}/rounds (API-S5-005) with its AssetSale answer and right U, declared once for the rounds story of RWB-E4-024 and this accept; the listings write the legacy endpoints table names is not declared here.
why: The TSD outranks the story master under §R3, only the round write answers with an AssetSale, and the legacy row would have put a third story on the price-and-floor write.
read: TSD S5 T-A.1 and T-A.2; API Specification v4 /listings/{listingId}/rounds; legacy RWB-E4-025 Endpoints
applied_in: RWB-S5-E4025-APP s7 and s12.1; RWB-S5-E4025-CON s12.1
confirm: Solution architect of S5 and the rounds story owner at the contract tag
impact: One operation, two baselines that must agree their posted fields; the accept is tested against the same fake as the round record.

text: The second signature is raised as the workflow kit's approval child on rwb-decision's queue, with the item, the level and the two-working-day clock declared as a reference in the baseline, and no REST operation of this service creates it.
why: No published operation creates an approval item, the approval record and the routing are P7's, and the S5 to P7 column of the connection matrix is Temporal only.
read: API Specification v4 /approvals; Architecture v5 slides 12 and 13; TSD S5 T5.2
applied_in: RWB-S5-E4025-APP s3, s4 and s12.5; RWB-S5-E4025-CON s12.5 and s12.8
confirm: Owner of rwb-decision (P7) and the workflow kit owner at the contract tag
impact: The approval is a Temporal child, not a REST row; a published create operation replaces the assumption in a minor version.

text: The slice traces to FEAT-AST-16 of the Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 and to FSD S5 A2.16 while the PRD reference reads Pending (C1).
why: The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice and no epic BRD requirement row for the feature is available.

why: The patterns of the slice are DP03, DP05, DP13 and DP19, which add only the decision-record and composite-route rows, and no source says which pattern carries the package load or the approval template.
